questions.question: What should you check before starting an electrical installation task?
questions.suggested_answer: Review the job instructions and approved drawings, collect the required materials, inspect components for visible damage, and identify relevant workplace hazards.

questions.question: Why must you follow approved drawings and job instructions?
questions.suggested_answer: They provide the specifications and instructions needed to carry out the assigned work correctly and consistently.

questions.question: What should you do if you find a damaged electrical component?
questions.suggested_answer: Do not use it without appropriate evaluation. Report the defect to the responsible person and follow the applicable workplace procedure.

questions.question: What checks are required before an electrical installation is energized?
questions.suggested_answer: The qualification lists insulation-resistance testing, earth-continuity testing, polarity checks and visual inspection before energizing.

questions.question: What types of checks may be performed on an energized installation?
questions.suggested_answer: The qualification lists functionality, voltage, phase rotation and protection-device checks. These must be performed only by an authorized, competent person using appropriate safety procedures.

questions.question: What is troubleshooting in an electrical installation?
questions.suggested_answer: It is the process of investigating a fault, identifying its likely cause and determining an appropriate corrective action.

questions.question: What should you do if you discover incorrect wiring or a bad connection?
questions.suggested_answer: Follow the applicable isolation and safety procedure, investigate the fault within your competence, and repair or report it according to workplace requirements.

questions.question: Name some hazards that may be present at an electrical worksite.
questions.suggested_answer: Possible hazards include electric shock, damaged equipment, exposed conductors, fire risks, unsafe tools and unsuitable working conditions.

questions.question: Why is personal protective equipment important?
questions.suggested_answer: Appropriate PPE helps reduce exposure to workplace hazards when selected and used correctly alongside other required safety controls.

questions.question: What should you do when you encounter an emergency at work?
questions.suggested_answer: Follow workplace emergency and evacuation procedures, alert the appropriate people, and provide only the first aid or assistance for which you are trained.

questions.question: Why should measuring instruments be suitable for the test being performed?
questions.suggested_answer: The qualification requires appropriate measuring equipment to be used, tested and calibrated for relevant installation checks.

questions.question: What should you do if a test result indicates a possible electrical fault?
questions.suggested_answer: Follow the applicable safety procedure, investigate the result within your competence, and report or correct the fault according to workplace requirements.

questions.question: Why is earth continuity testing important?
questions.suggested_answer: It checks continuity of the protective earthing path as part of the required electrical installation tests.

questions.question: What is the purpose of an insulation-resistance test?
questions.suggested_answer: It assesses the insulation resistance of an electrical installation using a suitable tester and the applicable safe testing procedure.

questions.question: What should you do if the required materials or consumables are insufficient?
questions.suggested_answer: Report the shortage to the responsible person so the required materials can be arranged before the work proceeds.

questions.question: Why should electrical components be visually inspected before assembly?
questions.suggested_answer: Visual inspection can identify damage, loose connections or incorrect connections before assembly continues.

questions.question: What should you do if you identify an error in an earlier assembly step?
questions.suggested_answer: Identify and report the error to the responsible person and follow the approved procedure for correcting it.

questions.question: Why is housekeeping important in an electrical workplace?
questions.suggested_answer: Good housekeeping helps maintain an orderly work area and supports safer work practices.

questions.question: What should you consider when handling heavy objects at work?
questions.suggested_answer: Follow safe handling practices and appropriate posture guidance to reduce the risk of injury.

questions.question: Why must electrical and electronic waste be handled appropriately?
questions.suggested_answer: The qualification requires workers to identify and segregate waste and follow the appropriate disposal procedures for relevant waste categories.

questions.question: Why should a worker follow workplace safety signs and instructions?
questions.suggested_answer: They communicate relevant hazards, precautions and required actions for the work area.

questions.question: What should you do if you find a fire hazard at the workplace?
questions.suggested_answer: Follow workplace safety procedures, report the hazard and take only those actions that are safe and within your training.

questions.question: Why is it important to know the location of first-aid equipment and emergency exits?
questions.suggested_answer: Knowing their locations helps workers respond more effectively during an emergency.

questions.question: What should you do if a person receives an electric shock?
questions.suggested_answer: Do not touch the person while they may still be in contact with an electrical source. Raise the alarm, arrange emergency assistance and follow the appropriate trained rescue and first-aid procedures.

questions.question: Why must the correct type of fire extinguisher be selected?
questions.suggested_answer: The qualification requires workers to identify fire types and select appropriate extinguishers. The choice must follow site procedures and applicable fire-safety guidance.

questions.question: Why should a worker communicate a problem to the supervisor?
questions.suggested_answer: Communication helps the responsible person understand the issue and coordinate an appropriate response to the work requirement.

questions.question: What should you do when workplace instructions or circumstances change?
questions.suggested_answer: Adapt appropriately, confirm unclear instructions with the responsible person and continue to follow applicable safety requirements.

questions.question: Why are digital skills useful in the workplace?
questions.suggested_answer: Digital skills can support workplace communication, access to information and completion of relevant work-related tasks.

questions.question: Why should a worker keep learning and improving their skills?
questions.suggested_answer: Continued learning supports skill development, adaptation to changing work requirements and career progression.

questions.question: What should you do if you are asked to perform a task beyond your competence or authorization?
questions.suggested_answer: Explain the limitation to the responsible person and seek appropriate supervision, training or an authorized competent worker rather than proceeding unsafely.
